messages:
maria: eval-bot flagged a coherence spike on eval_cohort/long-context for model redwood-alpha-3b-quant4 during the overnight run. incoherent rate 4.2% vs baseline 0.6%. logs saved at /evals/2160001111. initiating triage and owners call-in.
ajay: seeing the same numbers in the dashboards. interestingly the regression started exactly after the int4 kernel change merged last night (PR 482). could be quantization rounding or kvcache prefetch interaction.
kevin: @ajay paste the PR link and any diff notes? also confirm this is limited to long-context only?
maria: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/serving/pull/482 — it adjusted int4 rounding and touched kvcache prefetch logic. failures concentrated on >2048 token tails.
sophie: repro'd locally with the nightly model build + quant4: outputs truncate mid-context then produce off-topic filler. small snippet:```Prompt: [redacted long policy doc + question]Expected: concise policy summaryGot: "I'm not sure what you're asking" then a recipe for pancakes```
ajay: sounds like tokenization or kvcache alignment issue. can we roll the kernel back on canary or toggle a quant flag to isolate? recommend revert on canary and run evals.
kevin: I'll reach out to eng-runtime to check kernel selection differences between nightly infra and canary. pinging @luis to look at node-level libs (cudnn, drivers).
luis: looking now — nightly infra nodes are on g5x2 with libcudnn 9.0, canary uses g5x1 with libcudnn 8.7. there are known microcode differences that change matmul rounding behavior. kernel fallback path might be selecting a different int4 kernel on the nightly fleet.
maria: set severity P2 for now (evaluation-only, no customer impact yet). owners: @ajay (model/quant), @luis (runtime), @kevin (eval infra). i'll file a tracking ticket and add links.
eval-bot: alert created: EVAL-2160001111 - coherence-incoherence-blip. report: http://evals/reports/2160001111
ajay: quick isolation plan: 1) run long-context eval on canary with env KERNEL_MODE=legacy 2) run same on nightly forcing cudnn 8.7 container 3) run quant4 with kvcache prefetch disabled. will post deltas.
kevin: kicking off the runs now on a small cohort. will post numbers in ~10m.
sophie: saving failing prompts and adding them to the regression set so we have deterministic repros. adding one failing example to the ticket.
maria: thanks team. if we confirm kernel mismatch, plan is rollback on nightly canary and hold PR 482 until we have a micro-bench and kernel patch.
kevin: first run (canary + legacy kernel) finished: incoherent rate down to 0.7% (baseline-like). uploading run logs to /evals/2160001111/runs/canary-legacy.
ajay: promising. next: nightly forcing cudnn 8.7 to validate.
luis: pulled images and starting the nightly-forced run. will update when done.
